user.description: Add a heat pump on the Thermia Genesis controller platform.

real.description: Set up a heat pump on the Thermia Genesis controller platform.

emulated.description: Run a recorded heat pump inside Home Assistant on a loopback port. It never reaches a real device.

reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant reaches this heat pump. Its entities and history stay.

error.cannot_connect: The heat pump did not answer a read request.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump or firmware profile is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The heat pump connection was updated.
abort.emulated_not_reconfigurable: An emulated heat pump has no connection to change.
